definitions.explanation: The time from noon until evening, or the PM hours when telling time.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}に{会|あ}いましょう。
{午後|ごご}から{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}ります。
examples.english: It will rain from the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{午後|ごご}です。
examples.english: The meeting is in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}の{授業|じゅぎょう}は2{時|じ}から{始|はじ}まります。
{今日|きょう}の{午後|ごご}は{何|なに}も{予定|よてい}がないので、ゆっくり{休|やす}もうと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I don't have any plans this afternoon, so I'm thinking of taking it easy.

notes:
{午後|ごご} refers to the afternoon or PM hours (after noon until evening).

TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {午後|ごご}〜{時|じ}: X PM (e.g., {午後|ごご}3{時|じ} = 3 PM)
- {午後|ごご}から: from the afternoon
- {午後|ごご}{中|じゅう}: all afternoon

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {今日|きょう}の{午後|ごご}: this afternoon
- {午後|ごご}の{授業|じゅぎょう}: afternoon classes
- {午後|ごご}のひととき: an afternoon moment

CONTRAST:
- {午前|ごぜん}: AM, morning (before noon)
- {午後|ごご}: PM, afternoon (after noon)
- {正午|しょうご}: noon (exactly 12:00)

NOTE:
In Japan, 24-hour time is common in schedules (e.g., 15:00 instead of {午後|ごご}3{時|じ}), but {午後|ごご} is widely used in conversation.
